text:
sam (AE): FYI Meridian Health asked for SOC2 artefacts, ISO snapshot, a signed pen-test attestation scoped to the POC staging, and a scheduled window for their external scanner. Legal also asked whether the pen-test attestation can be our standard template or needs letterhead. Any blockers?

nina (Security): We can provide a SOC2 Type II excerpt and ISO 27001 statement quickly. Pen-test attestation: preferred on tester letterhead + Redwood sign-off. We can produce a vendor-signed letter but getting the tester to sign may be 2-4 business days. We can do a Redwood draft attestation within 24h.

omar (Solutions): Clarify scope: procurement often wants an artifact list + a few logs; security teams want full findings. Recommend we ask Meridian to split procurement vs security asks. For POC, an artifact index + network diagram + KMS rotation proof usually suffices.

sam (AE): They specifically want: network diagram, staging AWS account IDs, KMS key rotation excerpt, and a short pen-test attestation limited to the staging FQDNs. Also asking if Dedicated POC price changes if we provide single-tenant isolation.

kelly (Infra): For scanner allowlist we can offer ephemeral NATed IPs or a CIDR window. Example ephemeral for authenticated scans: `34.77.21.99` (NATed). For unauthenticated, we can open `3.120.0.0/15` for a scheduled window. Need scan start/end, ports, and target hostnames. Continuous access requires a ticket and separate approval.

nina (Security): Redaction policy: provide high-level severity summary for the POC; full vuln details go to the dataroom under NDA. Do not redact any item that indicates data exfiltration risk without escalation.

omar (Solutions): Pricing note: single-tenant network isolation adds a premium (estimate +20-30%). Pen-test itself doesn't change subscription pricing unless they require longer log retention or dedicated connectors. I'll prepare a placeholder quote if they confirm isolation level.

sam (AE): Procurement asked for artifacts within 3 business days. Is that doable?

nina (Security): Draft artifact pack + short Redwood attestation in 24h. Signed tester letter might not meet 3 days unless tester is available immediately.

kelly (Infra): If they accept scheduled windows, we can provide allowlist within 48h. Need the scan plan.

procurement-bot: note: SOC2 excerpt & ISO summary stored in compliance-bucket. Access via presigned link (NDA required).

sam (AE): Action items: 1) @nina produce draft attestation + artifact index in 24h; 2) @kelly propose ephemeral IP options and runbook in 48h; 3) @omar produce Dedicated quote placeholder with isolation and retention lines. I'll confirm scan scope and whether Meridian needs full reports or just an index.

nina (Security): Also: we cannot backdate attestations. Any attestation must reflect actual scan dates.

sam (AE): Got it. I'll update Meridian and loop back. :thumbsup:
